content: Produced a design-only proposal for bringing pmcro-runtime's MAF declarative-workflow/Harness/CodeAct architecture into pmcr-o, per the user's explicit request to design first, implement nothing yet. Grounded in a fresh re-check of pmcro-runtime's actual state rather than relying on the prior session summary: confirmed a live, read-only-scoped codeact-agent and CopilotKit-as-UI-layer, but also carried forward the project's own documented gaps (NOT YET LOAD-BEARING YAML, open migration-status.md gates, the Find() PowerFx SDK bug affecting both HIL and retry detection) so the proposal doesn't overstate maturity. Three graduated options offered (CodeAct pilot / Harness-style skill provider / full migration) with a risk register and a recommendation to pilot the smallest one first. Disposition is informational: this cycle's product is the decision-support document itself, not a decision -- the choice of option belongs to the user.
